title: work item
description: One row of GET /api/state/work: a live session, a dispatch run, a session parked on a usage limit, a merge request or a mission, in one shape (item_202).

project.description: Registry name: by cwd (worktrees under <path>.wt/ included), then the source's own project, then the largest usage share.

since.description: Start of the work, or its last change for MRs and missions.

wait_s.description: Seconds a needs item has waited on the owner.

resets_at.description: When a sleeping item's usage limit resets.

why.description: What makes the state, in a few words.

ref.description: pid, run id, conversation id, MR url or mission id.
